Product Details: This modern steam mop is engineered to provide a convenient solution for every day cleaning. It has a light weight construction for easy handling and it delivers an effective cleaning action without the use of any chemical The steam mop offers a 5-in-1 cleaning function that allows the user to quickly switch from a steam-mop to a versatile handheld steam cleaner The powerful steam cleaner can be used to clean your floors, mirrors, upholstery, tiles and more The steam cleaner features a high performance 1300-Watt motor that can deliver a powerful steam flow to clean grime and stubborn dirt instantly It offers a deep cleaning action on hard surfaces. When turned on, it gets the steam flowing within 30 seconds The 180° pivoting mop head offers easy manoeuvrability around furnitures and tight spaces. The auto-select feature automatically adjusts the amount of steam based on the surface that is being cleaned The mop features an easy glide micro fibre pad that lasts over 100 wash cycles. This pad provides ultimate cleaning performance.
